items.title: Being locally separated is fppf local on the base

items.difficulty_reason: The proof has two genuine halves: the direct implication from the cited base-change stability of local separatedness; and the converse, which identifies each base-changed diagonal \Delta_i : X_i \to X_i \times_{Y_i} X_i = Y_i \times_Y (X \times_Y X) as an immersion, observes that base change turns the fppf covering {Y_i \to Y} into an fppf covering of X \times_Y X, and descends the immersion property of \Delta from the covering via the diagonal form of the fppf descent lemma. The diagonal reformulation of local separatedness driving the descent is the substance.
